text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on my way back from shopping,
I passed by an arcade――

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I lost agaaain!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I couldn't get the top score on the dance game...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh, so frustrating!
I'm gonna keep going until I definitely win!!
choice_data_list: How about cutting down on mistakes with an easier song?
Let's take on the hardest difficulty and rack up points!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that'll do the trick!
In fact, it might even be a total breeze!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo restarted the game on a lower difficulty, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Muuu~... Uuu~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It felt so slow that my body just wouldn't move.
I messed up a whole bunch too...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Muuu, why is this happening!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps Twin Turbo is the type who shines best
when faced with greater difficulty.
choice_data_list: Let's try doing it on one leg.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whaaat, on just one leg?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That sounds fun...!
Turbo's gonna give it a shot!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, balancing on one foot is hard!
Turbo's getting all fired up now---!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!
I cleared it on one leg aloneeee!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha, this feels soooo good♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having completely forgotten about the high score,
Twin Turbo seemed cheered up by the sense of accomplishment
from clearing it on one leg.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Super hard...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I explained that on "Super Hard" mode, a massive wave of high-scoring notes comes pouring down.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hm...? So what's the plan?
choice_data_list: Just step on as many notes as you can!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I gotcha!
In that case, piece of cake, piece of cake.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: All right, time to take on the Super-Duper Miracle Hard mode, let's goooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Raring to go, Twin Turbo challenges the hardest difficulty,
but――

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhhh, the notes are way too faaast!
Turbo's gonna make shadow clones of herselfーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm gettin' fired up, though!
FULL THROTTLE ALL THE WAAAY!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my eyes are finally getting used to it!
Next time, I'm totally gonna nail itーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, though she didn't quite hit the top score,
Twin Turbo still managed to beat her personal best.
